description: Change a draft broadcast. Only the fields passed are changed. Refuses anything but a draft, since editing a scheduled broadcast can change who it reaches — unschedule it in the dashboard first.

anyOf.description: Where replies go, e.g. "Support <support@acme.com>". Defaults to the configured reply-to.

replyTo.description: Where replies go. Pass null to clear it.

anyOf.description: A saved template to use as the body instead of `html`.

topicId.description: Narrows the audience to this topic. Pass null to send to the whole audience.

trackClicks.description: Rewrite links through the tracking host to count clicks. Defaults to the account setting. Mailbox providers penalise the link mismatch, so leave it off unless clicks are needed.

trackOpens.description: Count opens with a tracking pixel. Defaults to the account setting. Off is better for deliverability.

name: update_broadcast

heldReason.description: Why the broadcast is held for review, when it is.

stats.description: Recipient counts by delivery status. Present on get_broadcast.

status.description: draft, scheduled, sending, sent, paused, held or cancelled.

title: Edit a draft broadcast
